mistake.headline:
Limp towel.
Just waving your arms.
mistake.body: Hold the towel loose and you're not doing anything. That's why so many guys think towel rows are a scam.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan pulling a towel tight in front of his chest, straining

fix.headline:
Pull it tight.
Stay tense.
fix.body: Pull hard on the towel before you even move it. My boy Mike Chang used to [em]karate chop people's towels.[/em] If yours collapses, you don't have enough tension.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan rowing a tight towel toward his chest

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for the towel row
items: Pull the towel apart hard before you row.
Stay tense the entire set, even on the way back.
Karate chop test: if it collapses, pull harder.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy who says towel rows are a scam.

cta.follow: One fix a week, filmed on me.
